## Reading and interface roles

<p id="foundation-prose">The page has different jobs for prose, controls, metadata, and code. A larger reading font does not need to enlarge every button. The current owned themes publish these choices in a paired foundation manifest.</p>

<figure><figcaption id="foundation-metadata">Updated 10 November 2026 · Reading profile · Shared specimen</figcaption></figure>

Use `theme: folio` or another installed theme name. A presentation profile is a separate consumer contract. It does not turn these document pages into slides.

```python
def keep_reading(notes):
    """Keep the text, type, and surface working together."""
    return [note for note in notes if note.is_useful]
```

## Feedback with words

<div class="alert alert-success" role="status">✓ Saved. Your reading note is ready.</div>
<div class="alert alert-warning">! Review needed. The title is very short.</div>
<div class="alert alert-danger">× Could not save. Add a title and try again.</div>
<div class="alert alert-info">i Tip. A short title is easier to find.</div>

<div class="mb-4"><label class="form-label" for="foundation-title">Note title</label><input class="form-control" id="foundation-title" value="A reading notebook"></div>
<div class="mb-4"><label class="form-label" for="foundation-invalid">Required title</label><input class="form-control is-invalid" id="foundation-invalid" aria-invalid="true" aria-describedby="foundation-error"><div id="foundation-error" class="invalid-feedback">× A title is required before saving.</div></div>
<div class="mb-4"><label class="form-label" for="foundation-select">Collection</label><select class="form-select" id="foundation-select"><option>Reading notes</option><option>Code examples</option><option>Working ideas</option></select></div>
